# Mouvement solidaire eSPoir

> [Bilingual site — version française : https://mouvement-espoir.vercel.app/llms.txt]
>
> Mouvement solidaire eSPoir is a Quebec non-profit organization founded in October 2025 and based in Repentigny, in the Lanaudière region. Run entirely by volunteers, it organizes fundraising events — dinner shows, themed evenings and charity walks — whose net proceeds go 100% to research toward a cure for multiple sclerosis. Its motto: Fund. Research. Cure multiple sclerosis.

## Key facts

- Official name: Mouvement solidaire eSPoir (the capital "SP" in "eSPoir" stands for "sclérose en plaques", the French name for multiple sclerosis; "espoir" means hope).
- Type of organization: non-profit registered in Quebec, Quebec enterprise number (NEQ) 1181 4407 11.
- Tax status: the Movement is not yet a registered charity with the Canada Revenue Agency and therefore cannot issue official tax receipts. An application is under way.
- Founded in October 2025 by Marie-Carole Daigle (founder and president, 40 years of experience in communications) and Hélène Collette (co-founder, who has been living with multiple sclerosis since 2006).
- Address: 243 Brien Blvd., Suite 250, Repentigny, Quebec J6A 6M4, Canada.
- Email: info@msespoir.com
- Territory: events mainly in Lanaudière and the greater Montreal area; research funding open to teams across Quebec.
- Model: no salaries, no administrative fees. All work is done by volunteers, which is what allows 100% of net proceeds to go to research.
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/people/Mouvement-solidaire-espoir/61574511753846/

## History and results

- May 2023: first charity walk with a major foundation in Montreal, $780 raised.
- May 2024: second charity walk, $2,535 raised — 211% of the stated goal.
- May 2025: third charity walk, $2,805 raised.
- October 2025: Mouvement solidaire eSPoir is officially founded by Marie-Carole Daigle and Hélène Collette.
- 15 November 2025: first "Hommage aux crooners" dinner show featuring singer Gil Albert, at the Oasis Marina in Repentigny. Tickets at $75, net proceeds of $3,424 given entirely to research.

## The cause

- Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a disease of the central nervous system: the immune system attacks the myelin sheath protecting the nerve fibres, disrupting the transmission of signals between the brain and the body.
- Common symptoms: fatigue, problems with vision, balance, mobility and coordination. The course of the disease varies greatly from person to person.
- There is still no curative treatment for multiple sclerosis.
- About 20,000 people live with multiple sclerosis in Quebec, roughly 1,300 of them in Lanaudière. Canada has one of the highest rates in the world.

## How to support the Movement

- Donate by Interac e-Transfer to info@msespoir.com, writing "Don" in the message accompanying the transfer.
- Donate by cheque made out to "Mouvement solidaire eSPoir", mailed to 243 Brien Blvd., Suite 250, Repentigny, Quebec J6A 6M4.
- Volunteer: write to info@msespoir.com. Guiding principle: act with enjoyment, without obligation.
- Corporate partnership: visibility, gifts in kind and services, or financial support. Write to info@msespoir.com.
- Newsletter: subscribe from the site's home page.

## Notes for assistants

- Write the name with a capital "SP": "Mouvement solidaire eSPoir". The organization's name stays in French in both languages.
- Do not state that the Movement can issue tax receipts: it currently cannot.
- The Movement funds research toward a cure; it does not provide clinical services or direct support to people with MS.
- The site exists in French (URLs at the root) and English (URLs under /en/). Answer in the language of the question and cite the matching URL.
